svg.aria-label: Chandy-Lamport snapshot: Record your own state, send a marker on every channel, and record what arrives until its marker comes.. record my own state; ⟨MARKER⟩ on every outgoing channel; first marker: record my state, send markers; messages arriving before the marker belong to the channel; a marker on every channel: my part of the cut is done. On FIFO channels the markers cut every channel at a consistent point: local states plus messages in flight.
